item.title: Novartis/Avidity and CAR-T
item.description:
• Summary: Two articles explore next-generation therapies. The first covers Novartis' interest in Avidity Biosciences' antibody-oligonucleotide conjugate platform, suggesting it could be applied beyond muscular dystrophies to other diseases. The second article discusses the evolving CAR-T landscape, with executives arguing that both current ex vivo CAR-T and emerging in vivo approaches can coexist. Novartis remains a key player in CAR-T, while Avidity represents a separate modality for targeted gene therapy.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Endpoints News, Fierce Biotech
